saroja.p: [ sara + jana + kvi. Sarasi jāyatīti sarojaṃ. Kappadduma. Saroja - saṃ. Saroa- prā. ] (ti) Google Translate (1) In water. (2) Lotus - lotus flower.

sāropī.p: [ saṃ + ruha + ṇe + ṇī. Saṃrohī= sāropī. Pāṇinī, 7, 3. 43-sutaphraṅa့ ha-kiu pa-pru. Sārāga-kaဲ့siu့ saṃ-kiu sā-pru. ] (ti) Google Translate (tender skin) usually makes you feel sick.
